preview.what: Composables, Pinia, and component patterns for larger Vue apps.
preview.picture: Composables are recipe cards again, Vue-flavoured; Pinia is the shared pantry.
preview.why: Eight years of Vue means you'll be asked how you organised a big app.
preview.bn: Composable = Vue-এর রেসিপি কার্ড, Pinia = শেয়ার করা pantry।
